notes.title: Demo Version 0.2 is now out on itch!
notes.notes:
Desktop Town just got its first Update!  Update includes:

A totally overhauled placing system that now only requires drag and drop without configuring the height of objects with the mouse wheel.

The mouse wheel now lets you rotate objects.

Added the railway set and a basic tram system for you to build in your town.

Improved AI

New UI

Many small bug fixes and performance improvements.



Have fun trying out the new stuff and stay tuned for more stuff to come :)
